dispositions.E and D5 \u00b7 MEA model selection: Both expanded 419-row fits improve the hot-pressure bias. Their legacy partial-pressure AARD rises by at least 11 percentage points from the F2 replay, above the 2-point limit. The incumbent has 251 qualifying measured-state searches out of 321 after pressure refinement. F2 has 253 and F4 has 248. The 162-state censuses have incomplete entries (F2 1, F4 1). No resolved descent was found in these finite screens. The exact #435 MEA declaration remains the historical carbamate donor.
dispositions.A \u00b7 MDEA reference pressure: At 383.15 K and 121.309 MPa the pressure-tracking split is confirmed. The 100 kPa reference split candidate lowers Gibbs energy. Its liquid-root check remains unresolved. The independent pressure-tracking correction is -15.7% of the EOS volume. The matched Engine enthalpies at the same composition coincide. The fixed-volume reference chain term is 17.55 kJ per feed.
dispositions.B \u00b7 MDEA measured-state census: The historical below-bubble group has 27 search attempts on 25 observations. 21 attempts overlap the 222 unfinished #435 searches among 1,564. 2 diagnostic IDs lack a current property row. The 4 Sobrino liquid-branch predictions exceed observations by 1.36–1.82 kg/m³. At 262.862 MPa the historical comparison reports a confirmed split and the salt case is unresolved.
dispositions.C \u00b7 MDEA pressure reweighting: Pressure AARD on 66 fitted loaded totals changes from 10.12% to 4.15% for salt and from 20.09% to 4.46% for the historical pair. The original-weight objectives worsen in both pairs. The original and RMS salt screens confirm 1 and 1 splits at different grid states. The historical RMS screen confirms 4 compared with 0 in the original historical grid census. Both RMS screens have more unfinished searches.
dispositions.D \u00b7 Declaration sensitivities: The MEA electrode discrepancy spans -0.150 to +0.138 pH on the digitized 197 points. Cai reweighting reduces its alternate objective and raises the original objective. Removing the MDEA binary bound produces 14 descents, 1 incomplete native search and a hull-onset bracket of 413.052–413.150 K. The AMP conditional slope profile brackets crossings near -155.7 and +47.2 K. 6 AMP inward variants retain unresolved phase identities at the historical absolute pressure after detecting descents. 6 MDEA inward variants leave the matched high-pressure split unresolved.
dispositions.DEA and F \u00b7 Broader measurement cov: The original DEA transfer replays the #435 objective exactly with the historical donor. The expanded 140-row objective falls from 26.43 to 15.54. The broadened fit confirms 4 measured-state splits. The search records retain 1 for unresolved descent and 1 for incomplete search. Seo–Hong pressure AARD is 66.20%, the 7 outside-fit Lawson rows have 37.20% AARD, and the Horstmann excess-enthalpy sign misses on 14 of 14 rows. The maximum conditional methane shift is 0.318 MPa for the refit. Dissolved methane effects remain unbounded by the experiment.
dispositions.AMP \u00b7 Inherited carbamate inputs: Both free- and fixed-slope AMP fits converge and preserve the donor checks. Their objectives are 75.11 and 76.35 on 214 rows, compared with 76.31 and 77.64 for #435. Each native and supplied-bank search completes all 666 declared states without a resolved descent. The historical absolute-pressure worked state has unresolved phase identity for the free-slope endpoint.
dispositions.H \u00b7 Source and package readbacks: Kuranov Table 2 row 72 is the unmatched observation after 81 source rows were matched. Historical Hartono S11 gives 1.1144% bubble-pressure AARD and 3.8890% vapor mole-fraction AARD. The strict canonical Hong group solves 132 equal-fugacity rows and fails the local test on 131. The study wheel and public package match 120 and 120 rounded S15 cells, respectively, with physical-check misses retained. The study wheel matches 85 historical S16 and 53 S17 cells at displayed precision. Public 1.3.2 matches 62 historical S16 cells at displayed precision and omits the plane-value error diagnostic. It matches 52 of 53 S17 cells. The revised S16 exercise retains the parent, trial and failed phase attempts at the same pressure. A future #430-qualified wheel is pending.
dispositions.Execution: A simultaneous SIGTERM ended the initial C and E searches before their configured limits. Its sender remains unverified. The reruns retained completed work and checkpointed batches. The retained timing and refusal records give each interruption, failed implementation check and recovery. The original execution exceeded the issue #436 limit of 4 workers total. Its execution record gives a cap of 12, with 5 E workers and 6 C workers.
